summary: F1: Window.Apply's text-frame rects run Shown.Put inside Parallel.For, so a refused rectangle (BadFrame) reaches the decode thread as an AggregateException (probed) and ends the host; fix at Shown (one door that bounds every part before decoding) with a test through it. F2: view.Apply swallows BadFrame silently where the window reports it. F3-F8 are smell findings (streamed predicate x2, Max read at three doors, int overflow in Shown.Decoded, Executor refusals, channel Actor null!, stale permission doc).
